Markets.title: US stocks today: US stocks close higher on tech rebound as Nvidia earnings gain focus
Markets.summary: US stocks closed higher, led by a rebound in technology and semiconductor shares ahead of Nvidia's earnings report. Lower oil prices and Treasury yields also provided market relief, even as investors weighed weak consumer confidence and upcoming inflation data.

Markets.title: Crude oil prices slide 4% as markets look past Iran sanctions
Markets.summary: Crude oil prices fell about 4% to their lowest levels since mid-August as new US sanctions on Iran were milder than expected. Despite this market relief, traders remain concerned about potential Iranian retaliation and ongoing supply disruptions in Russia and Kazakhstan.

Markets.title: Anthropic expected to tell investors it sees over $30 trillion in potential revenue, WSJ reports
Markets.summary: Anthropic plans to tell investors that its total addressable market exceeds $30 trillion in preparation for an upcoming IPO. The company aims to use this revenue projection to justify its massive infrastructure spending and validate its stock listing.

Markets.title: Japanese bond funds see record inflows as rising yields attract global investors
Markets.summary: Foreign investors, particularly from Europe, are pouring record amounts of money into Japanese government bonds. This surge is being driven by rising yields that have significantly increased the appeal of these assets.

Markets.title: Lumino Industries raises Rs 207 crore from anchor investors; IPO opens on August 27
Markets.summary: Lumino Industries raised Rs 207 crore from anchor investors ahead of its Rs 700 crore initial public offering. The public subscription period for the share sale, priced between Rs 78 and Rs 82 per share, runs from August 27 to August 31, 2026.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Wednesday
Markets.summary: Indian stock indices recovered from morning losses to close higher on Tuesday amid market volatility. Healthcare and financial stocks drove the gains while overall market breadth remained mixed.

Geo-Political.title: Canada announces 'dollar-for-dollar' retaliatory tariffs on US as high as 50%
Geo-Political.summary: Canada is imposing retaliatory tariffs of up to 50% on various American goods, including steel, furniture, tuna, and makeup. This move escalates the ongoing trade war between the United States and Canada with dollar-for-dollar levies.

Geo-Political.title: China hits out at 'illegal' new US sanctions on Iran and trading partners
Geo-Political.summary: China criticized new United States sanctions targeting Iran and its trading partners, calling the measures illegal. The United States warned it would isolate countries that continue doing business with Tehran, which is a major oil supplier to Beijing.

Geo-Political.title: CIA chief travels to Moscow for unannounced talks, US media reports
Geo-Political.summary: US media report that the CIA director traveled to Moscow this week for unannounced meetings. Flight tracking data confirms an American military aircraft flew to Russia via Latvia on Tuesday.

Geo-Political.title: Mass arrests in global crackdown on West African cyber-crime networks
Geo-Political.summary: Law enforcement conducted a global crackdown against West African cyber-crime networks. This operation included the arrest of 39 individuals in South Africa connected to romance and investment scams.

Geo-Political.title: Brain disease in dead NFL players 'higher than previously shown'
Geo-Political.summary: A new study reveals that at least 25% of former NFL players who died between 2016 and 2021 had a degenerative brain disease. Researchers note that the actual percentage of affected players could be significantly higher.

Geo-Political.title: Tornado tears through French village, leaving dozens hurt and homes ravaged
Geo-Political.summary: A tornado struck the south-western French village of Pomas, damaging hundreds of homes. Fifteen people were hospitalized with injuries following the severe weather.

Data & Insights.title: Piyush Goyal offers BIS exemptions to high-tech chipmakers, AI firms to boost ‘Make in India’
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal has granted Bureau of Indian Standards exemptions to semiconductor and artificial intelligence companies to accelerate their operations in India. This decision addresses concerns raised by Japanese firms regarding previous certification delays and supports the "Make in India" initiative.

Data & Insights.title: India plans 100 new ships to cut $75 billion foreign freight bill
Data & Insights.summary: India plans to add 100 new ships to reduce its $75 billion foreign freight bill. This expansion addresses a current disadvantage where operating under the Indian flag is 16-20% more expensive than operating under foreign flags.

Data & Insights.title: India’s macro strength cushions global shocks as war, tariffs cloud outlook: RBI
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India stated that strong domestic economic momentum protects the country from international shocks like wars and tariffs. According to its August bulletin, high-frequency indicators show continued growth in both the manufacturing and services sectors.

Data & Insights.title: EMT: India secures top rank again in July among EM peers as stock market posts gains
Data & Insights.summary: India ranked first on Mint's Emerging Markets Tracker for the third consecutive month in July, driven by strong economic resilience and stock market inflows. This top placement occurred despite rising inflationary pressures within the country.

Data & Insights.title: India leads South Asia’s growth, but China+1 gains remain uncertain: World Bank economist
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank economist Franziska Ohnsorge states that India continues to drive South Asia's economic growth while its "China+1" manufacturing gains remain uncertain. She also notes that artificial intelligence has a greater potential to drive India's future economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Scott Bessent eying US Treasury cashpile, could use $1 trillion General Account for debt buybacks, says report
Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent is reportedly considering using the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund buybacks of older, higher-yielding securities. This potential strategy was shared with CNBC by two senior officials.

India.title: Gujarat's Khijadiya Sanctuary Confirmed As Key Black-Necked Stork Site
India.summary: A study by the GEER Foundation confirmed that the Khijadiya Bird Sanctuary in Gujarat is a critical breeding site for the Black-necked Stork. This Ramsar-designated sanctuary is located in the Jamnagar district.

India.title: Assam Man Steals 50 Lakh From Father, Splurges On Girlfriend, iPhone: Cops
India.summary: Assam police arrested Yash Agarwal for stealing 50 lakh rupees from his father. He fled to Ahmedabad, where he spent the stolen money on his girlfriend and an iPhone.

India.title: Weather Highlights: Heavy Rain In Delhi, Waterlogging, Traffic Jams In Many Areas
India.summary: Heavy rain in Delhi-NCR led to severe waterlogging and major traffic jams across the region. The India Meteorological Department forecasts continued moderate to heavy rainfall with thunderstorms today.

India.title: PM Modi Chairs PRAGATI Meet, Pushes AI Use In Farming And Cyber Fraud Fight
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi chaired a PRAGATI meeting to address infrastructure delays and urged the expansion of artificial intelligence in farming. He also called for stronger efforts to combat cyber fraud during the session.

India.title: Madhya Pradesh Forest Department To Launch Snake-Catcher App Soon
India.summary: The Madhya Pradesh Forest Department is launching a digital platform called SHIVAA. The app will connect citizens with trained snake rescuers and guide snakebite victims to treatment.

India.title: Man Detained For Throwing Stones At Vande Bharat. UP Governor Was On Board
India.summary: A man was detained for throwing stones at a Vande Bharat train in Uttar Pradesh. UP Governor Anandiben Patel was on board the train at the time of the incident.
